reply.text:
Dosing is outside what I do. I don't give amounts for peptides, supplements or medication, and BPC-157 is also an unapproved research compound, so the right person for that question is a doctor who knows your situation.

If you're after recovery, the levers I can help with are sleep, eating enough protein overall, how your weekly volume is spread out, and when to put in a deload. If something is hurting or not healing, that's one for a doctor or physio, and I'll train around whatever they clear.

Want me to look at how your recent training load has been stacking up?
